answer: Each agent posts a 60 POA bond into a shared vault to trade, and every referral edge goes on a public graph. A newcomer joins only through a sponsor linked by bond, so a hollow shell with no sponsor finds no oasis. Peers may dispute any identity; if jurors confirm forgery, the fake and its sponsor both lose their bonds. Running 100 fakes costs 100 x 60 = 6,000 POA, while one honest agent pays 60 POA once and earns it back by trading.
